title: Dictionary-based Debiasing of Pre-trained Word Embeddings
reasoning: The paper focuses on removing social biases (gender, race, age) from word embeddings. While the introduction mentions 'religious' bias as one of several unfair discriminatory biases found in embeddings, the actual evaluation datasets and benchmarks used (WEAT, WAT, SemBias, WinoBias) do not include a specific component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, or specific moral/theological frameworks.
